scope: exploratory_full469; original frozen TEST results remain separately available
contrast_family: All headline_comparison_family entries crossed with the four native family endpoints
resampling_unit: Whole related groups, shared draws across methods within each family
simultaneous_intervals: Joint group bootstrap max absolute standardized centered error; approximately 95 percent across declared contrasts; separate pointwise intervals remain visible
degenerate_contrasts: Report zero bootstrap variation as a limitation; do not claim robust zero uncertainty or significance
partial_results: Pointwise intervals and explicit missing coverage only; simultaneous headline family computed when all declared usable contrasts are available, with blocked conditions disclosed
hallucination_endpoint: wrong / (wrong + off_topic + consistent), ratio of pooled source sums; both stages required
recovery_endpoints: Original full-question benchmark aggregation for multihop_mt, chain_intermediates, role_bound_association
interpretation: No multiplicity adjustment erases adaptive method history or creates a fresh held-out test; report effect sizes and practical tradeoffs
